BL-1604 — A tip-pure land replays backlog/standing-reds.tsv and the property-suite allowlist whole from the parcel's tip, so a row another OPEN ticket owns that went missing on the branch (a merge artefact, never a deliberate drain) is deleted from main by an unrelated land: BL-1548's land removed BL-1595's row on 2026-09-16 while BL-1595 was active and its file red, the register read unowned and the cap fell to 1; the land step restores from origin/main every register or allowlist row owned by an open ticket other than the landing one that the replay tree lacks, prints each restoration, and still lets the landing ticket's own rows leave
